children: Beach Energy achieved a very strong quarter operationally in 1Q, says Euroz Hartleys. Record revenue of A$565 million was supported by strong realized prices and improved production. "The company is on track to meet consensus production numbers, with a continued strong macro providing potential further upside to current earnings expectations," analyst Declan Bonnick says. Ahead of the update, Euroz Hartleys had forecast FY Ebitda of A$1.096 billion. Consensus hopes are for A$1.123 billion. Beach's share price ended Tuesday at A$0.91. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
